## Concern to cause

Start with a clear concern, identify what should normally happen, gather evidence, and narrow possible causes rather than replacing parts by guesswork.

## Service with evidence

Use measurements, specifications, visual inspection, safe procedures, and test results to justify technical decisions.

## Verify the result

A repair or adjustment is not complete until the original concern is checked again. Evaluation connects directly back to the initial need.
